messages:
Marco S.: Heads up — Koru Health renewal in ~6 weeks. Noticing seat activity down ~56% last 30d. Opening triage.
Priya N.: Thanks — what's the driver? Prod bug or org change?
Marco S.: No product bug. Their admin left and procurement paused while they evaluate a competitor pilot. We got that signal from their CS contact.
Lin W.: Pulled activity quickly. Query and yesterday snapshot below. DAUs went from ~220 -> ~95 over 30 days. Dashboard: https://redwood.app/dashboards/koru/activity (private link)
Lin W.: ```sql
SELECT date_trunc('day', ts) AS d, count(distinct user_id) AS dau
FROM events
WHERE org_id = 'koru'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1 DESC
LIMIT 30;
```
ops-bot: Export ready: /exports/koru_activity_1776001234.csv (s3://redwood-exports/1776001234_koru.csv)
Jonah R.: Ok, proposed play: quick enablement + 2-week "value sprint" to prove ROI and reanchor PM. Can we re-engage their new PM with a mini-PoC ask? Priya, can you lead scheduling?
Priya N.: On it. I'll schedule a 30m "value re-run" with their PM. Need one-pager + 2 short case studies. Lin — can you support demo and sandbox?
Lin W.: Yep. I can spin a sandbox with tuned prompts & embeddings and run a 3-family prompt benchmark. ETA 48h once we have sample prompts.
Marco S.: I'll draft the one-pager and churn-risk note. Suggest playbook: 1) immediate QBR invite, 2) sandbox demo + benchmark, 3) short funded pilot (discounted), 4) weekly check-ins.
Priya N.: Procurement is the gating factor — Alicia (their buyer) asked for comparative perf and cost. Can we run a prompt benchmark and share an eval snapshot ASAP?
Lin W.: I can run 3 prompt families against their dataset and our best quantized model. Need sample prompts + consent. Marco, can you request samples in the customer thread?
Marco S.: Asked the customer for sample prompts and got verbal ok. They also asked for a cost estimate for a small dedicated config for the pilot. Jonah — can you pre-seat a small config and draft a quote?
Jonah R.: We can pre-quote. Need infra check for reserved capacity in us-west-2. @ops-bot — can you surface current capacity?
ops-bot: Reserved capacity availability (us-west-2): GPUs available — RTX6000 x6, A100 x2. Recommend A100 for throughput benches. Inventory page: https://infra.redwood/sku/status
Priya N.: I'll mention A100 recommendation in the call. Also propose a "proof-of-impact" credit (25% credit for pilot) to lower procurement friction.
Marco S.: Action items (owners): Priya — schedule 30m w/in 48h; Lin — create sandbox + run bench; Jonah — draft pre-quote + confirm infra; Marco — prep one-pager + loop in exec sponsor.
Priya N.: I'll update CRM with play and mark account as "at-risk — competitive pilot".
Lin W.: Will post bench outputs here when ready. Plan to surface: tokens/sec, p50/p95 latency, and accuracy delta on evaluation prompts (compare against baseline).
Marco S.: :thumbsup: Thanks team. If we can get them into a pilot within 2 weeks we're likely to recover renewal. Reconvene after sandbox results.
Jonah R.: Escalation path: if no re-engagement by day 7, escalate to AE exec intro and ask Legal to fast-track PO terms. Noted.
